# mermaidly

> mermaidly is a free, single-page web tool for rendering Mermaid diagrams. Paste Mermaid code and the diagram renders instantly in the browser — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, and more. Export to PNG or SVG, or share a diagram via a URL that encodes the source.

All rendering happens client-side in the browser. There is no account system, no server-side storage, and no tracking. Shared links encode the diagram source in the URL fragment, so diagram data never reaches a server.

## App

- [mermaidly](https://mermaidly.app/): The diagram editor and renderer. Paste Mermaid code on the left, see the rendered diagram on the right.

## Reference

- [Mermaid documentation](https://mermaid.js.org/intro/): Syntax and diagram types supported by the underlying Mermaid library.
- [Source code](https://github.com/earthpyy/mermaidly): The project repository on GitHub.

## Notes

- mermaidly is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Mermaid project.
- Diagrams are rendered with mermaid.js v11.
